question: Can a prospectively sealed in-our-time/in-a-prior-age and present/former-era bank serve as pristine confirmation for the frozen top-16 plus 1.25-gain M11 program?

all is/was capability priors and immutable receipts

prior_art.known_lessons: Capability must precede causal outcomes; output or activation reconstruction is not the task objective; v19 established only a stable partial core and participated in gain calibration. Unequal cue lengths are legal only with explicit final-suffix alignment in later causal code.
prior_art.novelty: No v20 bank exists. Sixteen reporter nouns, all target texts, all row IDs, and both target construction surfaces are history-disjoint from v1-v19. The bank is sealed after the exact top-16 indices and global gain 1.25 were frozen but before any v20 model or causal outcome.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides; no v20 intervention, factor score/order, subspace, gain, gradient, or causal outcome is read.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder/digests, construction checks, full-history target-text/row-ID/reporter novelty, and exact 64-row inventory pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_a_panel_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least .75.
predictions.pred_c_joint_capable_population: Each 16-row A panel has at least 12 rows for which both native base and donor predictions are correct.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples, zero interventions/backwards/updates, and no v20 causal, factor, gradient, or gain outcome access.

decision: A pass freezes exact v20 rows for immutable fixed-program confirmation. A null closes this bank without causal repair and requires a separately authored construction.
